pairs.evidence: crates/shadowrunr-reconcile/Cargo.toml:3 The crate analyses simulated stream runs and mechanically checks what an LLM proposes (evidence refs in verify.rs, character diffs in check_diff). A case-insensitive search of crates/shadowrunr-reconcile for conformance, conformant, checker and severity returned 0 hits, so the subject's precondition (building a conformance checker for a repository standard) does not hold here.
